import sys, os, hashlib, shutil
from pathlib import Path
sys.stdout.reconfigure(line_buffering=True)

CACHE_DIR = "/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache"
MANUAL_DIR = "/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/manual_datasets"

def sha256_file(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(8192), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()

arc_rev = "210d026faf9955653af8916fad021475a3f00453"
hub_dir = Path(CACHE_DIR) / "hub" / "datasets--allenai--ai2_arc"
blobs_dir = hub_dir / "blobs"
snap_dir = hub_dir / "snapshots" / arc_rev
refs_dir = hub_dir / "refs"

for d in [blobs_dir, snap_dir, refs_dir]:
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

(refs_dir / "main").write_text(arc_rev)

# Also need to download and cache the README.md and .huggingface.yaml metadata
# But for offline mode, the parquet files should be enough

local_dir = Path(MANUAL_DIR) / "allenai_arc"
for f in sorted(local_dir.rglob("*.parquet")):
    rel = f.relative_to(local_dir)
    sha = sha256_file(f)
    
    blob_path = blobs_dir / sha
    if not blob_path.exists():
        shutil.copy2(f, blob_path)
        print(f"  blob: {sha[:12]}... ({f.stat().st_size} bytes)")
    
    link_path = snap_dir / rel
    link_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if link_path.exists() or link_path.is_symlink():
        link_path.unlink()
    
    rel_blob = os.path.relpath(blob_path, link_path.parent)
    link_path.symlink_to(rel_blob)
    print(f"  link: {rel} -> {rel_blob}")

print("\nVerification:")
for f in sorted(snap_dir.rglob("*")):
    if f.is_file() or f.is_symlink():
        target = f.resolve() if f.is_symlink() else f
        size = target.stat().st_size if target.exists() else -1
        print(f"  {f.relative_to(snap_dir)}: {size} bytes")

print("DONE")
PYEOF
